### What is a RACI Chart?

A RACI chart (or matrix) maps out project tasks against team roles to prevent confusion and overlapping duties.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX55kqRtT4IihwUko0F3uvppdbR8SKIb6EYez8kE2tHlVTi3rnwjbsHz6PfjFVwxRyzcU4uZ1fVghoTAO2BL44YsSwtOPMiH-3o-4EAu5Knl1eO5xnkRyOpI4QUvCMhJtKp0W5DWcdb5uKb6GOgGloFv2oBgscrnqX7EA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX5SjqGpiXfIPhYTgjNo6Lh7dMkhVQXZqgPQ0mpCDfPcxJg1Bwu2L_5Xlx8dLxO5syxI6gpuGCCU4ZMyPd0mOfqLZjvzeK_6TZRBjKlkxF_qcoS8MdFarKlzFo9rTplLrg)

The acronym stands for:

- **R — Responsible:** The person who actually does the work to complete the task.
- **A — Accountable:** The single person who has final approval and owns the outcome (only one "A" per task).
- **C — Consulted:** Subject-matter experts whose input is needed before or during the work.
- **I — Informed:** People who need updates on progress after decisions or steps are completed.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TZzjNemlrXk&t=19)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX5HgVSwmJQkyQ0LpE4y-68Ckn37V0riCZm1nNSrLSEeTz3nmyLlHqXprz4dpLc_tQw6Q9Y9zdrqKZjL11iFnSx63Xe6WC60s9af_wG5I2AM6dxMypwOpfMFXUqyd4o3s)

### Top Platforms for RACI Templates

- **Spreadsheets:** Use the [AIHR RACI Template Guide](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX5SjqGpiXfIPhYTgjNo6Lh7dMkhVQXZqgPQ0mpCDfPcxJg1Bwu2L_5Xlx8dLxO5syxI6gpuGCCU4ZMyPd0mOfqLZjvzeK_6TZRBjKlkxF_qcoS8MdFarKlzFo9rTplLrg) for downloadable Excel, Google Sheets, Word, and PowerPoint layouts.
- **Visual Workspaces:** Build a collaborative diagram using the [Lucidchart RACI Chart Template](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXCzVhD3nrTsabVzAxwCrKJ7KXlakWSrbSVNxP0eMj72RHWEqw54CUvr47acNvuZI9gbiGkGV46sx4rnY_8S75rNmtZy4mwkoz1L28VFEB01iNo7k7_WD5w089XNZH) or [FigJam RACI Matrix Template](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXwj_hmVYLzyIIRXXu9AKwLRJa7-IZuk-4iLDnrfi3lghAfmzYIvSj-_uJTxDkphciiETVVWlXNWZVPtifgjyxjhHiuOI-UcXJd6vegZQMNWGZaiSfj6q9pAfQQwtAvTwTxiHCBzoQgBRThgHRVA).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXX5SjqGpiXfIPhYTgjNo6Lh7dMkhVQXZqgPQ0mpCDfPcxJg1Bwu2L_5Xlx8dLxO5syxI6gpuGCCU4ZMyPd0mOfqLZjvzeK_6TZRBjKlkxF_qcoS8MdFarKlzFo9rTplLrg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXCzVhD3nrTsabVzAxwCrKJ7KXlakWSrbSVNxP0eMj72RHWEqw54CUvr47acNvuZI9gbiGkGV46sx4rnY_8S75rNmtZy4mwkoz1L28VFEB01iNo7k7_WD5w089XNZH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXwj_hmVYLzyIIRXXu9AKwLRJa7-IZuk-4iLDnrfi3lghAfmzYIvSj-_uJTxDkphciiETVVWlXNWZVPtifgjyxjhHiuOI-UcXJd6vegZQMNWGZaiSfj6q9pAfQQwtAvTwTxiHCBzoQgBRThgHRVA)
